{{Quote|The fortress we're invading is on the planet Taral Five. Enemy territory, protected by Imperial warships. Too many to fight.|[[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="TOR:TJP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Prisoner|the ''Telos''}}</ref>}}
This '''[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] facility''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taral V]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] strike team was sent there to gather information on a [[Revan/Legends|missing Jedi]].<ref name="TOR:T5" />
